finding.title: No check sets the DHW minimum above the lowest sweep candidate; dropping the usable-energy clamp moves the advice unseen
finding.claim: _dhw_setpoint_sweep clamps a candidate's usable band at zero (max(t - dhw_min_temp, 0)). With the clamp dropped, a candidate below dhw_min_temperature gets negative usable energy; when every demand window has learned a zero-kWh heaviest draw (twenty empty occurrences), those candidates stop meeting it and the recommendation moves 48 -> 56 at a 55 C minimum. The full gate does not notice. (The baseline itself recommends 48 C below a 55 C minimum in that state: a lead.)
finding.metric_definition: dhw_advisor recommended_setpoint at dhw_min_temperature 55, dhw_setpoint 60, every window's learned draw reservoir twenty 0.0 kWh occurrences
